card.name: Patient in overdose case reports
card.fires_on: The word 'who' or a noun like 'man' or 'patient' right after a single person is introduced in an overdose case report. The next words are expected to describe the person taking or ingesting a drug amount.

modes.label: Who after a patient
modes.description: The word 'who' following a patient or aged person in an overdose report, just before ingested or had taken.
modes.example: A 19-year old male<< who>> had taken 8,000

modes.label: Person noun after age
modes.description: The noun man or patient after an age or 'a', just before an act of ingesting or injecting a dose.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE A 62-year-old<< man>> accidentally injected 25 mg of ap

card.writes: It promotes forms of the verb 'take' (taking, takes), predicting that the person took a drug.
card.plain: It spots a single patient in an overdose case report, where the next words say what they took.
